task.title: Process an existing warehouse request from the request list
task.shortdesc: Use this guide to process an existing warehouse request from the request list.

ul.li: Master data: A warehouse request exists and is not processed.

step.cmd: Choose the 🔍 icon, enter Warehouse Requests, and then choose the related link.
Select the record you want to work with.

info.p: Process the selected warehouse request and mark it as processed.

step.cmd: Close the Warehouse Requests page. Business Central saves your changes.

ul.li: The warehouse request is marked as processed.
